changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Replace unconstrained double-precision derived metrics with explicit numeric scales. Coordinates intentionally remain unchanged. The view is dropped and recreated in the same transaction because PostgreSQL will not alter column types while gps_track_v depends on them.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE gps_track ALTER COLUMN track_duration_in_motion_secs TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(track_duration_in_motion_secs::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN track_duration_stopped_secs TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(track_duration_stopped_secs::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN track_longest_stop_secs TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(track_longest_stop_secs::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN ascent_in_meter TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(ascent_in_meter::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN descent_in_meter TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(descent_in_meter::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN min_altitude TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(min_altitude::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN max_altitude TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(max_altitude::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN speed_in_kmh_30s_max TYPE numeric(8,2) USING round(speed_in_kmh_30s_max::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN elevation_gain_per_hour_30s_max TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(elevation_gain_per_hour_30s_max::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN elevation_loss_per_hour_30s_max TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(elevation_loss_per_hour_30s_max::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN slope_percentage_max TYPE numeric(8,2) USING round(slope_percentage_max::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN slope_percentage_min TYPE numeric(8,2) USING round(slope_percentage_min::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN energy_gravitational_total_wh TYPE numeric(16,2) USING round(energy_gravitational_total_wh::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN energy_gravitational_descent_wh TYPE numeric(16,2) USING round(energy_gravitational_descent_wh::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN energy_aero_drag_total_wh TYPE numeric(16,2) USING round(energy_aero_drag_total_wh::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN energy_rolling_resistance_total_wh TYPE numeric(16,2) USING round(energy_rolling_resistance_total_wh::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN energy_kinetic_positive_total_wh TYPE numeric(16,2) USING round(energy_kinetic_positive_total_wh::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN energy_net_total_wh TYPE numeric(16,2) USING round(energy_net_total_wh::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN energy_weight_kg_used TYPE numeric(8,2) USING round(energy_weight_kg_used::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN power_watts_avg TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(power_watts_avg::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN power_watts_moving_avg TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(power_watts_moving_avg::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN power_watts_max TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(power_watts_max::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN power_watts_30s_max TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(power_watts_30s_max::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN normalized_power_watts TYPE numeric(12,2) USING round(normalized_power_watts::numeric, 2), ALTER COLUMN exploration_score TYPE numeric(4,3) USING round(exploration_score::numeric, 3);
COMMENT ON COLUMN gps_track.energy_gravitational_total_wh IS 'Track-level energy total in Wh, stored at numeric(16,2). Per-point energy columns keep higher scale because tiny segment values are summed before these display-oriented totals are persisted.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN gps_track.energy_gravitational_descent_wh IS 'Track-level energy total in Wh, stored at numeric(16,2). Per-point energy columns keep higher scale because tiny segment values are summed before these display-oriented totals are persisted.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN gps_track.energy_aero_drag_total_wh IS 'Track-level energy total in Wh, stored at numeric(16,2). Per-point energy columns keep higher scale because tiny segment values are summed before these display-oriented totals are persisted.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN gps_track.energy_rolling_resistance_total_wh IS 'Track-level energy total in Wh, stored at numeric(16,2). Per-point energy columns keep higher scale because tiny segment values are summed before these display-oriented totals are persisted.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN gps_track.energy_kinetic_positive_total_wh IS 'Track-level energy total in Wh, stored at numeric(16,2). Per-point energy columns keep higher scale because tiny segment values are summed before these display-oriented totals are persisted.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN gps_track.energy_net_total_wh IS 'Track-level energy total in Wh, stored at numeric(16,2). Per-point energy columns keep higher scale because tiny segment values are summed before these display-oriented totals are persisted.';
ALTER TABLE gps_track_data ALTER COLUMN precision_in_meter TYPE numeric(8,2) USING round(precision_in_meter::numeric, 2);
changeSet.createView: SELECT gt.id, gt.file_id, gt.creator, gt.gpx_version, gt.meta_name, gt.meta_description, gt.meta_time, gt.meta_author, gt.track_name, gt.track_description, gt.start_date, gt.end_date, gt.track_duration_in_motion_secs, gt.track_duration_stopped_secs, gt.track_stop_count, gt.track_longest_stop_secs, gt.median_distance_between_points, gt.avg_distance_between_points, gt.statistics_exclusion_reason, gt.garmin_activity_id, gt.meta_link, gt.update_date, gt.duplicate_details, gt.bbox_min_lat, gt.bbox_max_lat, gt.bbox_min_lng, gt.bbox_max_lng, gt.center_lat, gt.center_lng, gt.energy_gravitational_total_wh, gt.energy_gravitational_descent_wh, gt.energy_aero_drag_total_wh, gt.energy_rolling_resistance_total_wh, gt.energy_kinetic_positive_total_wh, gt.energy_net_total_wh, gt.energy_weight_kg_used, gt.power_watts_avg, gt.power_watts_moving_avg, gt.power_watts_max, gt.power_watts_30s_max, gt.normalized_power_watts, gt.source_segment_index, gt.source_parent_track_id, gt.exploration_status, gt.exploration_score, gt.exploration_calc_date, gt.track_source, gt.planner_profile, ixf.index AS f_index, ixf.name AS f_name, ixf.path AS f_path, ixf.base_path AS f_base_path, ixf.full_path AS f_full_path, ixf.size AS f_size, ixf.indexer_id AS f_indexer_id, ixf.last_modified_date AS f_last_modified_date, ixf.index_added_date AS f_index_added_date, ixf.index_update_date AS f_index_update_date, ixf.indexer_status AS f_indexer_status, ixf.last_message AS f_last_message, gd.id AS gd_id, gd.create_date AS gd_create_date, gd.precision_in_meter AS gd_precision_in_meter, gd.track_type AS gd_track_type, gd.track AS gd_track, gd_raw.id AS gd_raw_id, gd_raw.track AS gd_raw_track FROM gps_track gt LEFT JOIN indexed_file ixf ON gt.file_id = ixf.id LEFT JOIN gps_track_data gd ON gt.id = gd.gps_track_id AND gd.precision_in_meter = 1 AND gd.track_type = 'SIMPLIFIED_SHAPE' LEFT JOIN gps_track_data gd_raw ON gt.id = gd_raw.gps_track_id AND gd_raw.precision_in_meter = 0 AND gd_raw.track_type = 'RAW_OUTLIER_CLEANED'
